query:
-- Simular exatamente o que a procedure faz com o email do Vinicius
SELECT 
  fr.id,
  fr.vessel_name as vesselName,
  fr.liters / 100 as liters,
  fr.total_amount / 100 as totalAmount,
  fr.payment_status as paymentStatus,
  fr.client_email,
  fr.created_at as createdAt
FROM fuel_records fr
LEFT JOIN bookings b ON fr.booking_id = b.id
WHERE fr.client_email = 'v6h2sw5vmn@privaterelay.appleid.com'
ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC;
